verdict.rationale: WorkOS publishes an official Node SDK on GitHub (`npm install @workos-inc/node`). It documents real developer ergonomics: automatic retries with exponential backoff and jitter on transient errors, and a client-ID-only mode for apps that can't store secrets. An OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json supports generating typed clients. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages, in-depth SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
